Bayshore Landing Marina
2550 S Bayshore Dr
Coconut Grove, FL 33133

FYI Yachts, in collaboration with BTE, is proud to host Sunset Bash, an exclusive marine lifestyle experience at Bayshore Landing in Miami on May 31 and June 1, from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM each day. This two-day event is designed to bring together boating enthusiasts, luxury lifestyle brands, and prospective buyers for an engaging showcase of high-performance vessels, innovative technologies, and curated experiences.

Throughout the event, attendees will have the opportunity to participate in live sea trials aboard the acclaimed NHD 325, 355, and 365 models. These Brazilian boats have rapidly gained recognition for their advanced hull designs, efficient performance, and open decks, offering a sophisticated blend of sport utility and elegance. Each test ride will allow guests to experience firsthand what distinguishes NHD vessels in both craftsmanship and capability.

NHD 365

NHD 355

NHD 325

On Saturday evening, guests will be invited to the official unveiling of the new 315 NHD. Positioned as a more accessible alternative to the popular 325 model, the 315 retains the brand’s signature design elements and versatile layout while introducing a streamlined profile for added efficiency. Powered by twin Mercury Verado V8 300 engines, it offers strong performance without compromising comfort. Its debut at Bayshore Landing highlights FYI Yachts’ commitment to delivering innovative, high-quality vessels to the U.S. market.

Complementing the on-water experience, the event will feature prominent partners across the automotive, lifestyle, and audio industries. RL Carking Collision, known for their extensive portfolio of exotic and luxury automobiles, will be displaying a curated selection of approximately ten vehicles. This presence enhances the lifestyle element of the event, allowing guests to engage with premium mobility solutions that parallel the exclusivity and design language of the showcased vessels.

Center Consoles Only (CCO), one of the most influential media and community platforms in the center console boating world, will attend with a branded vessel and team representatives. They will introduce the CCO Boat Club, a new initiative that gives members access to select boats and experiences under a premium club membership model.

DS18, a global leader in high-performance audio systems for marine, automotive, and powersports markets, will also be featured. The brand will present its latest marine-grade speaker and subwoofer offerings through an immersive demonstration, setting the atmosphere with music played directly from their custom Jeep equipped with the same audio components available to NHD boat owners. This dynamic showcase highlights the powerful sound experience DS18 brings both on land and at sea.

The weekend will include additional partner activations and appearances from brands whose products and services complement the luxury marine lifestyle. From high-fidelity sound to refined design and networking opportunities with fellow boating aficionados, this event promises to deliver a holistic experience for those passionate about performance and elegance on the water.
Join us at the Sunset Bash for an exceptional weekend where innovation meets lifestyle on the waterfront. We look forward to welcoming you to Bayshore Landing.
